items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: Uh, and the old man, uh, we called him Papai.

ctx.x: You said you were in the studio, you told him. Right.

You were there, of course. Well, it's a banjo, uh, like, and, of course, you had another great one, but I don't think he was quite as great as Caffer. It was John, John Morello. Well, he was, he was tremendous. Then, all right, then you go down into, uh, to the clarinets like Lorenzo T.O. Jr. Uh, and the old man, uh, we called him Papai. Uh, huh. That taught all of us how he's a symphony man. Uh, huh. Those guys read music just like the newspaper. I imagine that. I was talking to my professors' daughters last…
